stem:
Meena's grandmother says that a meal is balanced only if it makes the stomach feel completely full. Meena learns in school that a balanced diet must contain all essential nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts for proper growth and development.

Which statement about a balanced diet is correct?

options.text: A diet is balanced if it fills the stomach, even if roughage or water is missing.
A balanced diet contains all essential nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts, and these needs can change with age.
A child and a grandparent need exactly the same types and amounts of nutrients.
A diet is balanced if it has many different food items, even without checking the amounts.

teacher.key_rationale: B states the defining rule: all essential nutrients, roughage and water in the right amounts, with needs varying by age. A and D are the 'full stomach / many items' trap; C is the same-needs-at-all-ages trap.
